text:
The heart is the organ that pumps blood.

In the quiet rhythm of the town, the heart beat not just within chests, but in the spaces between people. It was the steady drum beneath the melody that haunted every character's story, a lingering reminder of the lullaby that once brought them peace. This melody appeared in the most unexpected places—a whistler in the street, a distant radio, the chime of a bell—each note a pulse in the collective vein of the community. The motif of the melody tied their stories together, underscoring the shared experiences that knit the fabric of the community, much like the heart’s relentless rhythm binds life to the body.
